items.title: Nintendo Wii
items.line: The Wii launched in North America on 19 November 2006 at $249.99, with Wii Sports in most boxes. It was codenamed Revolution and has sold about 101 million units.

items.title: Twitter
items.line: Twitter was created in March 2006 and opened to the public on 15 July. Posts were limited to 140 characters, and that limit stayed until 2017.

items.title: Zidane's headbutt
items.line: The 2006 World Cup final in Berlin on 9 July ended 1-1 after extra time. Zidane headbutted Materazzi in the 108th minute and was sent off. Italy won 5-3 on penalties.

items.title: Casino Royale
items.line: Daniel Craig's first Bond film opened in the UK on 16 November 2006. Martin Campbell directed, Chris Cornell sang "You Know My Name", and it took about $606 million.

items.title: Borat
items.line: Borat opened on 3 November 2006 in the US, taking $26.4 million that weekend on an $18 million budget. It finished near $262.6 million, with Sacha Baron Cohen as the star.

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada
items.line: Released in the US on 30 June 2006, with Meryl Streep as Miranda Priestly and Anne Hathaway in the cerulean sweater scene. It grossed $327 million and got Streep her 14th nomination.
